segments.text: How would you design an API endpoint for job applications?
I would make a route and save the data. I have not built an application API before.
What should happen if the client retries after a timeout?
I would probably send the request again. I do not know how to prevent duplicate records.
How would you investigate a slow database query?
I would restart the service and see if that fixes it. I have not used a query plan.
How would you test the workflow?
I would click through the page manually. I have not written automated tests for APIs.
What security risks would you consider?
I would use a password. I do not know how uploaded files or access permissions should be handled.
